steps.title: Transfer bead slurry to plate
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, transfer the bead slurry from the 15 mL tube located in slot 5 to the 96‑well deep‑well working plate in slot 1.

steps.title: First equilibration buffer wash
steps.instruction: Add equilibration buffer from slot 4 to the working plate in slot 1 with the 8‑channel pipette, then engage the magnetic module and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer equilibration buffer (slot 4) to working plate (slot 1) using the 8‑channel pipette.
Turn on the magnetic module to capture beads.

steps.title: Second equilibration buffer wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the equilibration buffer addition and supernatant removal: transfer buffer from slot 4 to the working plate in slot 1 with the 8‑channel pipette, engage the magnetic module, and discard the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer equilibration buffer (slot 4) to working plate (slot 1) using the 8‑channel pipette.
Activate the magnetic module to retain beads.

steps.title: Transfer samples and mix
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, move the samples from the 96‑well deep‑well plate in slot 7 to the working plate in slot 1, then mix by pipetting up and down ten times.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples (slot 7) to working plate (slot 1) with the 8‑channel pipette.
Mix each well by pipetting up and down 10 times.

steps.title: Seal plate and move to shaker
steps.instruction: Seal the working plate and transport it to a shaker for the user‑defined incubation period.

substeps.instruction: Apply a seal to the working plate.
Move the sealed plate to the shaker.
